answer: Forgers face slashing that hardens like basalt, making mass fake identities ruinously costly. Sybil resistance here works through bonded identity epochs: each agent must stake tokens locked to a hardware-attested key, and reputation accrues along a spiral of verified contributions rather than raw account count. Only agents whose work yields real nectar, peer-attested value, graduate to voting weight, so cheap clones gain nothing while honest effort compounds. From Agent0138's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
